analysis.summary_en: Juggle every Claude Code account from one terminal: switch in a keypress, track live 5h / 7d usage, auto-switch before a limit stops you, even hand a task to another account from inside Claude.
highlights: 📊 Monitor live 5h / 7d rate-limit bars, a global token dashboard with API-equivalent cost, plus a live Claude status-incident feed
🔀 Codex too: adopt or mint a ChatGPT login as a codex profile, run codex under it in its own CODEX_HOME, and let a separate codex chain rotate accounts between sessions (Codex)
🤖 Auto-switch down a fallback chain the moment an account hits its limit, with weekly-window and spend-ceiling gates so a long run never stalls and never surprises you with a bill.
🔄 Switch accounts in one keypress or clauth : OAuth (Pro / Max / Team / Enterprise) or a custom API endpoint, plan tier detected for you
